title: Independent F-MR31 Exact Runtime-Forcing-Bound Root-Uptake Attribution Requalification

branch_hygiene.reason: genuinely independent requalification must reconstruct evidence from canonical source plus the exact pinned production candidate, not inherit owner test/evidence history

candidate_acquisition: materialize only from exact owner_candidate:candidate_path into qualification build space and verify blob identity; do not copy candidate production source into the qualification branch

prior_failure_authority.counterexample: physical candidate created from forcing A booked 2.40625 root mass_out, while detached repair with valid forcing B published 4.125 attribution

qualification_rule: independent oracle and independent runtime/transaction fixture; F-MR31 owner oracle is not qualification evidence and need not be compiled
frozen_scope: one immutable root-extraction vector per outer interval [t0,t1]
actual transpiration is attribution of already-booked root extraction and is never a second mass booking
root-inactive and noncommitted columns publish no attribution
active zero root extraction may publish an available zero amount
hard_negative_gates: the former F-VQ48 valid-wrong-forcing repair path must be structurally absent from the public candidate interface
per-column attribution must follow the exact resolved forcing_handle even when registry order, column order and execution order differ
changing or inspecting another valid forcing after a committed result exists must not be able to alter or recompute that result attribution
no attribution may publish for a noncommitted column
no additional generic mass_out booking may be introduced
independent_matrix: permuted forcing registry identities with nonmatching column order
shared forcing handle across multiple columns
distinct valid forcing handles with deliberately different integrals
batch sizes 1, 2, 5 and reversed input order
by-value result persistence after unrelated forcing object mutation
real production backend compatibility and root-mass preservation
nonclaims: time-varying qrot within an accepted outer interval
oxygen, salinity, frost, compensation, MICRO, Jong-van-Lier or macropore uptake
